decision: Fix the mobile rail offset as a code defect; record discovery without changing intended layout behavior.
rationale: At a 655px viewport the sidebar is fixed with width56 while the main region begins at x0. Reserve collapsed-rail space below48rem. The user can report bugs in the active conversation; only changed/missing requirements need a spec amendment. Repeated issue categories are candidates for reviewed process improvements, not automatic global instructions.

discovery.observation: Turn content is hidden under the collapsed navigation rail in a narrow panel.
discovery.cause: The library fixes its mobile icon rail but the consuming shell does not offset the main region.
discovery.regression: Browser check at narrow width: main left edge must be at or after rail right edge; expanded/desktop and reader layout remain usable.
